name: craft
description: Software craftsmanship discipline skills: grill (the interview primitive — walk a decision tree one question at a time, facts looked up rather than asked, no acting until shared understanding), grill-with-docs (that loop applied to vocabulary, against per-repo CONTEXT.md glossaries), diagnose, prototype, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture, grok (stateful multi-session codebase comprehension with supersession-aware understanding records), zoom-out (adapted in part from mattpocock/skills, MIT), infra-review (architecture/security review of Terraform+Atlantis PRs), quiz-me (opt-in active-recall comprehension check after a code explanation), interrogate-model (holistic representability review of a domain model — the legitimate scenarios and personas it cannot express), design-by-stories (design an artifact's shape — schema, template, data model, config — by modeling its actors and user stories first, then deriving the shape from the stories), and lucid-architecture-diagram (drive AWS cloud architecture diagrams in Lucid, including the two silent-failure modes of its API). Composes with spec-flow and ndr plugins.
